svg.title: Plate PL-05 — DNA: geometry and the layered error budget
svg.desc: An engraved-style encyclopedia plate in seven panels. Panel I draws the B-form duplex to scale at 7 pixels per angstrom from two sourced constants — a rise of 3.4 angstrom per base pair and a 20 angstrom envelope diameter — and marks both groove widths NOT-SOURCED. Panel II plots base pairs per turn as an unreconciled contest: 10.0 from fibre diffraction, 10.4 plus or minus 0.1 in solution (Wang 1979), 10.6 plus or minus 0.1 in solution (Rhodes and Klug 1980), with 10.5 marked as a printed value of untraced provenance. Panel III compares the A, B and Z families. Panel IV gives the persistence length, about 50 nanometres. Panel V draws the layered error budget as three successive filters — polymerase base selection, proofreading, mismatch repair — with the modelled error rate and errors per diploid copy after each, and fences the decades against Schaaper 1993 measured fold-discriminations. Panel VI draws the packing hierarchy and marks the 30 nanometre fibre CONTESTED in vivo. Panel VII carries the key, the caption and what the plate does not claim.
svg.text: UNI ENCYCLOPEDIA & COOKBOOK · NATURA WING
PLATE PL-05
DNA — GEOMETRY AND THE LAYERED ERROR BUDGET
Source chapter: CN-05 (cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-05-dna.md) · draws rows CN05-01…CN05-44 of the chapter's 62 in encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md · corpus tip f1be794
~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned
ZERO UNI CLAIMS ON THIS PLATE
A nature citation is never a UNI gate.
I
THE B-FORM DUPLEX — drawn to scale, 7 px per Å

CONSTRUCTION — what drives this drawing, and what does not.
Two SOURCED constants set every dimension: the rise, 3.4 Å/bp (CN05-01), and the 20 Å envelope
(CN05-07). Nothing else here is measured. Three things are CONSTRUCTION CHOICES, not values:
the 10.5 bp/turn the drawing had to pick (II); the 0.4-turn backbone offset; and therefore the
0.4 / 0.6 turn groove spans bracketed above. Those spans are drawn from the offset — they are not
a measurement of groove width, and no groove width is printed on this plate, because none is
traceable in this corpus (CN05-08 / 09 / 10). The plate asserts the grooves' ALTERNATION and the
20 Å envelope. See the caption, note 3.

svg.text: II
bp PER TURN — a contest, not a constant

g.text: bp / turn
fibre diffraction
Watson & Crick 1953
solution · topoisomer
Wang 1979, PNAS
solution · DNase I
Rhodes & Klug 1980
10.5 ◇ — printed; provenance NOT-SOURCED (CN05-06)
▲ THIS PLATE IS DRAWN HERE — a drawing must choose
‡ UNRECONCILED — CN05-05
Two primaries, the SAME nominal condition (solution), two assays — a topoisomer ladder against a DNase I cutting periodicity.
Rhodes & Klug identify their 10.6 with the repeat IN SOLUTION, so this is not "two conditions, both right": it is a
method-dependent discrepancy, and CN-05 does not reconcile it. 10.5 is neither primary's number. CN-05 records the
midpoint story as its own NEGATIVE ✗, now corrected. Quote 10.5 as shorthand; never as a receipt.

svg.text: III
THE THREE FAMILIES — more than one stable conformation

g.text: A-DNA
B-DNA
Z-DNA
sense
right

LEFT

B-DNA's bp/turn is printed here as 10.5 ◇ (CN05-06, provenance NOT-SOURCED); cf. 10.4 ± 0.1 and 10.6 ± 0.1 in solution ‡ and 10.0 in fibre — see II.
A-DNA also carries a 9 Å axial hole and ~20° base-pair tilt (CN05-11). B: CN05-01 / 06 / 07. Z: CN05-12 — left-handed, 30°/bp, solved at atomic
resolution (Wang et al. 1979, Nature 282:680). Z-DNA is not a curiosity invented to fill a table.
The molecule has MORE THAN ONE stable conformation, and which one it occupies depends on sequence and environment.
A design that treats DNA as one fixed geometry has already lost information.

svg.text: IV
MECHANICS — the constant that makes it an object

g.text: ℓ
p
dsDNA · ~0.1 M NaCl · ~20–25 °C · tweezers + AFM consensus · CN05-13
< ~150 bp : stiff rod
> ~150 bp : flexible coil (worm-like chain)
‡ TEMPERATURE IS PART OF THE SCOPE. 53.2 nm (5 °C) → 42.5 nm (42 °C) — Geggier et al. 2011 (CN05-14). Measured in TBE + 10 mM
MgCl₂: a DIFFERENT ionic condition, so it is a CONDITION ON the 50 nm consensus, not support for it. At ≥37 °C it sits at or below
that row's own 45–55 nm falsifier band.
‡ Sub-100 bp DNA is MORE bendable than the worm-like chain predicts (Vafabakhsh & Ha — CN05-15). The 50 nm value is a
large-scale property, not a licence to extrapolate to short loops.
WHY IT MATTERS AT VI-2: wrapping 147 bp around a histone octamer bends DNA through ~1.65 superhelical turns AT its persistence
length. That is not free. Something has to pay, and the histones pay it with binding energy. The nucleosome is a PROBLEM, not a
convenience — which is the whole reason a packing hierarchy exists at all.

svg.text: V
THE LAYERED ERROR BUDGET — three cheap filters, multiplied

pre-selection
◇ CN-05 carries NO pre-selection rate. None is invented here.
SCREEN 1
polymerase base selection
SCREEN 2

mismatch repair
gain: a fold, not a rate — 200,000–2,000,000×
errors per bp △

cf. ≈ 610,000 at the in-vitro 10⁻⁴ rung ‡

6.11 Gbp diploid · one replication
errors per bp △

measured overall band 10⁻⁹–10⁻¹¹
‡ THE DECADES DO NOT REPRODUCE FROM THE MEASUREMENT
The rungs above are Fijalkowska, Schaaper & Jonczyk 2012's round-decade estimate — a REVIEW's
convenience, hedged by its own "roughly." They compose exactly (10⁻⁵ × 10⁻² × 10⁻³ = 10⁻¹⁰)
because they were CHOSEN to land there. Schaaper 1993's MEASURED fold-discriminations on a 10⁻⁵
rung span ~10⁻⁷·⁹ to ~10⁻⁹·⁹ — reaching 10⁻¹⁰ only at the most generous edge. △ CN05-32.
✗ CN-05 records its own prior misattribution of these decades to Schaaper as a NEGATIVE.
✗ It also records a rung of 10⁻⁴ → 10⁻⁷ under a stated gain of 10¹–10² as arithmetically impossible.
‡ THE FIRST RUNG IS CONTESTED THREE WAYS
≈ 10⁻⁴ in vitro (Kunkel 2004) · ≈ 10⁻⁵ a review's in vivo estimate (Fijalkowska et al. 2012) ·
measured in vivo in yeast, base selectivity >100× BETTER than in vitro (St Charles et al. 2015),
which would push the rung below 10⁻⁶. CN-05 did not reconcile them and prints no reconciliation.
Proofreading is also strand-asymmetric (Pol ε leading vs Pol δ lagging) and on average contributes
more than MMR — but the split runs from nearly all proofreading of some mismatches to mostly MMR
of others. ‡ CN05-29 / CN05-33.
THE PRINCIPLE — which survives every discrepancy above:
Nature did not build one perfect component. It stacked three cheap imperfect ones, each individually unimpressive, and multiplied their INDEPENDENT failure
probabilities. A ~10⁻⁵ part, a ~10⁻² filter and a ~10⁻³ filter compose to 10⁻¹⁰. No single element in the chain is remarkable. The chain is. The independence is the
whole trick — correlated failures collapse the product back toward the worst layer. Note what the argument needs: layers that are cheap, stacked and uncorrelated.
It needs NO particular rung — which is fortunate, because the rungs are the softest numbers in the chapter.

✗ NEGATIVE / conflation trap: 10⁻¹⁰ is NOT the polymerase's error rate. It is the rate after three layers. Stipple density is SCHEMATIC, not proportional — 61,000 : 610 : 0.6 cannot be drawn to scale.

svg.text: VI
THE PACKING HIERARCHY — 2 m into 6 µm, and the level that is not there

g.text: THE ARITHMETIC — derived, never cited
3.055×10⁹ bp × 0.34 nm/bp = 1.04 m (haploid)
≈ 2.08 m (diploid) △ CN05-37
nucleus d = 6 µm: V = (4/3)π(3 µm)³ = 113 µm³ △ CN05-38
packing ratio = 2.08 m / 6×10⁻⁶ m ≈ 3.5×10⁵ △ CN05-40
But run the VOLUME, which almost nobody does.
DNA as a cylinder of r = 1 nm:
V = π(10⁻³ µm)² × 2.08×10⁶ µm = 6.5 µm³
6.5 / 113 ≈ 5.8 % of nuclear volume △ CN05-39
THE NUCLEUS IS 94 % NOT-DNA.
Packing is NOT a space problem. It is a TOPOLOGY and
ACCESS problem: keep 2 m of a 50-nm-persistence-length
polymer untangled, unbroken and selectively readable.
Volume was never the constraint. That reframing is the point.
NOT-SOURCED ◇ is not NOT-MEASURED.
NOT-MEASURED = nature has not been asked — a fact about the
world's knowledge. NOT-SOURCED = we cannot say who asked —
a fact about US. Collapsing them would let a research failure
masquerade as a discovery about the frontier of science.
NA-00, amended 2026-07-15. Never merge them.
THE LEVELS — with the fence applied where it is owed
1 · THE DUPLEX
20 Å (2 nm). Panel I. OBSERVED-REPLICATED.
2 · THE NUCLEOSOME — solid
146 bp @ 2.8 Å (Luger et al. 1997) · 147 bp @ 1.9 Å (Richmond &
Davey 2003) · 1.65 left-handed superhelical turns · histone octamer.
Two numbers, TWO CRYSTALS, BOTH REAL. Nucleosomal DNA carries
"twice the curvature necessary" — the bending is not gentle.
CN05-41 · OBSERVED-REPLICATED
3 · THE 30 nm FIBRE
‡ CONTESTED
OBSERVED-CONTESTED in vivo — CN05-42
It is in every textbook. It is NOT in the near-native evidence.
· Cryo-EM of vitrified human mitotic cells, imaged close to native
state: NO 30-nm fibres (Maeshima, Hihara & Eltsov 2010).
· ChromEMT electron tomography: chromatin is a disordered chain,
no 30-nm fibre (Ou et al. 2017).
ChromEMT needs fixation, dehydration, heavy-metal staining and
plastic embedding; cryo-ET does not. Two methods with DIFFERENT
artifacts agree anyway — which is why this is strong.
The fibre is well established IN VITRO. Textbook diagrams drawing it
inside a living nucleus are ahead of the evidence.
FALSIFIER: a near-native in-vivo method resolving regular 30-nm fibres.
4 · WHAT IS ACTUALLY OBSERVED in vivo
A disordered 5- to 24-nanometer-diameter curvilinear chain,
packed at varying 3D concentration. ChromEMT, interphase and
mitosis (Ou et al. 2017). OBSERVED-REPLICATED.
5 · LOOPS / TADs / CHROMOSOME
◇ NOT-SOURCED
The levels above the chain. CN-05 carries NO value for them.
FALSIFIER: fetch Hi-C / loop-extrusion primaries. CN05-44

svg.text: VII
KEY, CAPTION, AND WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM

g.text: FIGURE KEY — marks, not colours (this plate must survive greyscale)
OBSERVED-REPLICATED
measured, and independently replicated across labs, datasets or taxa.
OBSERVED-CONTESTED
measured, but the community genuinely disputes it. Both positions carried; the dispute named.
MODELED
derived from a model that fits data. THE ASSUMPTIONS ARE THE FENCE.
NOT-SOURCED
a value this corpus could not trace to a source. A gap in OUR homework, not in the literature.
NEGATIVE / trap
a conflation or a defect, recorded first-class — never deleted, never mocked.
Classes are NATURA classes (NA-00, amended 2026-07-15: twelve classes in three groups — measured / derived / fenced). They are SOVEREIGN from the UNI fence
(proven · designed · hypothesized · not-yet-built) and never merge. Line weight, hatch density and dash pattern carry every distinction that colour carries.
CAPTION
1 · The duplex (I) is drawn to scale at 7 px per ångström from two sourced constants only: the rise, 3.4 Å (0.34 nm) per bp (CN05-01), and the 20 Å (2 nm) envelope
diameter (CN05-07). The base-pair rungs stand at the true rise; line weight thins with depth as an engraving convention, carrying no quantity.
2 · bp per turn (II) is drawn at 10.5 because a drawing must choose a number. 10.5 is NOT a measurement this corpus can trace: it is printed by Potaman & Sinden's
Table 1 as B-DNA's residues per turn, and whether it is an independent determination, a rounding or a midpoint is NOT-SOURCED ◇ (CN05-06). The two solution
primaries — 10.4 ± 0.1 (Wang 1979, topoisomer ladder) and 10.6 ± 0.1 (Rhodes & Klug 1980, DNase I periodicity) — are two assays of the SAME quantity under the
SAME nominal condition, and they are unreconciled ‡ (CN05-05). The fibre value 10.0 (Watson & Crick 1953) is a different scope: fibres are not solution.
3 · Groove widths are NOT-SOURCED ◇, NOT NOT-MEASURED (CN05-08 / 09 / 10). Two pairs circulate — ~12 / ~6 Å and 22 / 12 Å — differing by 10 Å in the major groove.
The ~5.8 Å convention offset (phosphate–phosphate separation vs van der Waals-corrected) accounts for the minor pair (12 − 5.8 = 6.2 ≈ 6) but FAILS on the major
(22 − 5.8 = 16.2, not 12), so "different convention" is not a sufficient explanation, and the offset is itself unsourced here. A groove width quoted without its
convention is underspecified. The groove BRACKETS in panel I mark 0.4 / 0.6 turn axial spans that follow from the drawn 0.4-turn backbone offset — a construction,
not a measurement. CN-05 records a FABRICATED citation for the 12/6 pair as its own most instructive failure — committed in the very passage that lectures
"name the convention or do not print the number." This plate does not repeat it.
4 · The error cascade (V) is MODELED △ at every rung. The decades 10⁻⁵ → ×10⁻² → ×10⁻³ → 10⁻¹⁰ are a review's round estimate (Fijalkowska, Schaaper & Jonczyk 2012)
which composes exactly — and does not reproduce from Schaaper 1993's measured fold-discriminations (200,000–2,000,000× / 40–200× / 20–400×), which on a 10⁻⁵
rung span ~10⁻⁷·⁹ to ~10⁻⁹·⁹ (CN05-32). Errors per diploid copy assume 6.11 Gbp and one replication (CN05-34). Stipple density is schematic, not proportional.
5 · The 30 nm fibre (VI-3) is drawn as a ghost and marked CONTESTED ‡ because its status as an IN VIVO structural level is contested (CN05-42): two independent
near-native methods fail to find it. What is drawn solid at VI-4 is what was actually observed — a disordered 5–24 nm curvilinear chain (CN05-43). VI-5 is drawn
empty on purpose: the levels above the chain are NOT-SOURCED ◇ in this pass (CN05-44), and an empty box is the honest drawing of an untraced level.
6 · The germline rate 1.20×10⁻⁸ per nucleotide per GENERATION (Kong et al. 2012 · CN05-35) is deliberately ABSENT from panel V. It has a different denominator from the
per-replication rates, and setting the two side by side is a recorded conflation trap ✗. A generation contains many germline divisions.
WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
· Not claimed: any groove width. Both circulating pairs, and the ~5.8 Å convention offset that supposedly reconciles them, are NOT-SOURCED ◇ in this corpus.
· Not claimed: that 10.5 bp/turn is a measurement, that it is a midpoint, or that it reconciles 10.4 and 10.6. It is the number this drawing had to choose to exist.
· Not claimed: that the fidelity ladder's rungs are settled. They are assay-dependent, assembled from different systems against different denominators, and the first
rung is contested three ways. The STACKING PRINCIPLE survives the discrepancy; the SPECIFIC RUNGS do not travel without their assay.
· Not claimed: that the 30 nm fibre does not exist. It exists in vitro. Only its status as an in vivo structural level is contested, and it is carried as contested.
· Not claimed: that this plate's geometry is DNA's only geometry. A-, B- and Z-forms are all real (III); which is occupied depends on sequence and environment.
· Not claimed: that DNA is a program, source code, or a blueprint. CN-05 records that reading as INADMISSIBLE as stated — a metaphor doing argumentative work with
no falsifier attached. This plate draws a physical polymer with measured dimensions, not a specification.
· Not claimed: that anything here raises any UNI rung. A NATURE CITATION IS NEVER A UNI GATE. This plate contains ZERO UNI claims, and the honest program position
is unchanged by it: ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned. "Full human" and "beyond human" appear nowhere as targets — they are permanent open questions.
